question: Which of the following countries hosted the first assembly of International Big Cat Alliance in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India hosted the first assembly of the International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) in June 2025**. The event marked a significant milestone in international conservation efforts for big cats.
 
• The International Big Cat Alliance was established to foster cooperation among nations for the conservation of big cats such as tigers, lions, leopards, and snow leopards, among others.
 
• **The first assembly was held in New Delhi, India**, reflecting India's prominent role in wildlife conservation and its commitment to protecting big cat species.
 
• India is home to several big cat species, including the **Bengal tiger**, which is the national animal of the country, as well as leopards, snow leopards, and Asiatic lions.
 
• The assembly focused on strategies such as habitat protection, anti-poaching measures, and community involvement to ensure the survival of these iconic species.
